部署物ID。

您可以通过[ListArtifacts - 查询部署物列表](~~469993~~)获取部署物ID。
description.en:
The ID of the artifact.

Call [ListArtifacts](~~469993~~) to obtain the artifact ID.

description.en:
The version of the artifact.

Call [ListArtifactVersions](~~469995~~) to obtain the artifact version.

description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。**ClientToken**只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
description.en: A client-generated token that ensures the idempotence of the request. Make sure that the token is unique for each request. **ClientToken** supports only ASCII characters and must be no more than 64 characters long.
